title: Lightmap creation fails with panic index out of bounds in Bevy 0.16+

labels.name: A-Rendering
labels.description: Drawing game state to the screen

labels.name: P-Regression
labels.description: Functionality that used to work but no longer does. Add a test for this!

labels.name: S-Ready-For-Implementation
labels.description: This issue is ready for an implementation PR. Go for it!

body:
## Bevy version and features

- Originally seen when I was migrating to Bevy 0.16.
- But I also made a repro for Bevy 0.17-dev/main based off 5df73e138.

## Relevant system information

```
INFO bevy_diagnostic::system_information_diagnostics_plugin::internal: SystemInfo { os: "macOS 15.5 Sequoia", kernel: "24.5.0", cpu: "Apple M1 Max", core_count: "10", memory: "64.0 GiB" }
INFO bevy_render::renderer: AdapterInfo { name: "Apple M1 Max", vendor: 0, device: 0, device_type: IntegratedGpu, driver: "", driver_info: "", backend: Metal }
INFO bevy_render::batching::gpu_preprocessing: GPU preprocessing is fully supported on this device.
INFO bevy_winit::system: Creating new window lightmaps_bug (0v0)
```

## What you did

- I came across the bug in my game by spawning a level.
- Then exiting the level—all level entities and related asset handles are torn down.
- Then load a second level.
- The game crashes.

## What went wrong

Panic:

```
thread '<unnamed>' (569947307) panicked at crates/bevy_pbr/src/lightmap/mod.rs:372:35:
index out of bounds: the len is 2 but the index is 2
stack backtrace:
```

That's https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/90c5c123c64537dbdef19674676096177cb5acbb/crates/bevy_pbr/src/lightmap/mod.rs#L371-L372.

## Additional information

- I made a repro. I think it's not quite the most minimal repro you could create, but you can reliably use it to repro.
- Drop the code over `lightsmaps.rs` example and run it: `cargo run --example lightmaps`
- Press `SPACE`.
- Then press `A`.
- Then just wait a few moments for the crash. It crashes after the log `Phase 0: Creating 16 lightmaps with SAME asset (cycle 1)`.
- Even though the lightmaps themselves don't look correct in the example, I don't think that is relevant for the underlying bug which is an index out of bounds issue. Happy to be proven wrong here, but I think the meshes I set up are still valid for lightmaps, it's just that they don't _look_ good _at all_.
- When you follow those steps, the output is as follows:

//! Reproduction of the lightmaps index out of bounds bug.
//! This example creates many lightmaps and then creates/destroys them
//! to trigger the bug.

use argh::FromArgs;
use bevy::{
    asset::Handle,
    core_pipeline::prepass::{DeferredPrepass, DepthPrepass, MotionVectorPrepass},
    image::Image,
    input::{keyboard::KeyCode, ButtonInput},
    mesh::VertexAttributeValues,
    pbr::{DefaultOpaqueRendererMethod, Lightmap},
    prelude::*,
};
use bevy_render::render_resource::Extent3d;

/// Demonstrates lightmaps bug reproduction
#[derive(FromArgs, Resource)]
struct Args {
    /// enables deferred shading
    #[argh(switch)]
    deferred: bool,
    /// enables bicubic filtering
    #[argh(switch)]
    bicubic: bool,
}

#[derive(Resource, Default)]
struct State {
    cycle_count: u32,
    lightmap_entities: Vec<Entity>,
    lightmap_handles: Vec<Handle<Image>>,
}

fn main() {
    #[cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))]
    let args: Args = argh::from_env();
    #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
    let args: Args = Args::from_args(&[], &[]).unwrap();

    let mut app = App::new();
    app.add_plugins(DefaultPlugins)
        .insert_resource(AmbientLight::NONE)
        .init_resource::<State>();

    if args.deferred {
        app.insert_resource(DefaultOpaqueRendererMethod::deferred());
    }

    app.insert_resource(args)
        .add_systems(Startup, setup)
        .add_systems(Update, (handle_input, auto_cycle))
        .run();
}

fn setup(mut commands: Commands, args: Res<Args>) {
    // Camera
    let mut camera = commands.spawn((
        Camera3d::default(),
        Transform::from_xyz(0.0, 5.0, 10.0).looking_at(Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::Y),
    ));

    if args.deferred {
        camera.insert((
            DepthPrepass,
            MotionVectorPrepass,
            DeferredPrepass,
            Msaa::Off,
        ));
    }

    // Instructions
    commands.spawn((
        Text::new("Press SPACE to create lightmaps\nThen press 'A' to auto-cycle\nThis should trigger the lightmap bug"),
        Node {
            position_type: PositionType::Absolute,
            top: Val::Px(10.0),
            left: Val::Px(10.0),
            ..default()
        },
        TextColor(Color::WHITE),
    ));
}

#[derive(Resource)]
struct AutoCycle {
    timer: Timer,
    active: bool,
    phase: u32,
}

impl Default for AutoCycle {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            timer: Timer::from_seconds(1.0, TimerMode::Repeating),
            active: false,
            phase: 0,
        }
    }
}

fn auto_cycle(
    time: Res<Time>,
    mut auto_cycle: Local<AutoCycle>,
    mut state: ResMut<State>,
    mut commands: Commands,
    mut images: ResMut<Assets<Image>>,
    mut meshes: ResMut<Assets<Mesh>>,
    mut materials: ResMut<Assets<StandardMaterial>>,
    keyboard: Res<ButtonInput<KeyCode>>,
    args: Res<Args>,
) {
    if keyboard.just_pressed(KeyCode::KeyA) {
        auto_cycle.active = !auto_cycle.active;
        println!("Auto-cycle: {}", auto_cycle.active);
    }

    if !auto_cycle.active {
        return;
    }

    auto_cycle.timer.tick(time.delta());

    if auto_cycle.timer.just_finished() {
        auto_cycle.phase += 1;

        match auto_cycle.phase % 6 {
            0 => {
                println!(
                    "Phase 0: Creating 16 lightmaps with SAME asset (cycle {})",
                    state.cycle_count
                );

                // Create a dummy lightmap image.
                let lightmap_handle = if state.lightmap_handles.is_empty() {
                    let mut image = Image::default();
                    image.resize(Extent3d {
                        width: 32,
                        height: 32,
                        depth_or_array_layers: 1,
                    });
                    let handle = images.add(image);
                    state.lightmap_handles.push(handle.clone());
                    handle
                } else {
                    state.lightmap_handles[0].clone()
                };

                for i in 0..16 {
                    let entity = create_lightmapped_cube(
                        &mut commands,
                        &mut meshes,
                        &mut materials,
                        &lightmap_handle,
                        &args,
                        i as f32 * 2.0,
                    );
                    state.lightmap_entities.push(entity);
                }
            }
            1 => {
                println!("Phase 1: Removing 5 lightmaps");
                let len = state.lightmap_entities.len();
                let entities_to_remove: Vec<_> =
                    state.lightmap_entities.drain(0..5.min(len)).collect();

                for entity in entities_to_remove {
                    commands.entity(entity).despawn();
                }
            }
            2 => {
                println!("Phase 2: Adding 8 lightmaps with DIFFERENT assets");
                for i in 0..8 {
                    // Create new unique lightmap images.
                    let mut image = Image::default();
                    image.resize(Extent3d {
                        width: 64,
                        height: 64,
                        depth_or_array_layers: 1,
                    });
                    let lightmap_handle = images.add(image);
                    state.lightmap_handles.push(lightmap_handle.clone());

                    let entity = create_lightmapped_cube(
                        &mut commands,
                        &mut meshes,
                        &mut materials,
                        &lightmap_handle,
                        &args,
                        20.0 + i as f32 * 2.0,
                    );
                    state.lightmap_entities.push(entity);
                }
            }
            3 => {
                println!("Phase 3: Removing all lightmaps");
                for entity in state.lightmap_entities.drain(..) {
                    commands.entity(entity).despawn();
                }
            }
            4 => {
                println!("Phase 4: Forcing asset cleanup by removing handles");
                state.lightmap_handles.clear();
            }
            5 => {
                println!("Phase 5: Creating lightmaps after cleanup");
                for i in 0..12 {
                    let mut image = Image::default();
                    image.resize(Extent3d {
                        width: 128,
                        height: 128,
                        depth_or_array_layers: 1,
                    });
                    let lightmap_handle = images.add(image);
                    state.lightmap_handles.push(lightmap_handle.clone());

                    let entity = create_lightmapped_cube(
                        &mut commands,
                        &mut meshes,
                        &mut materials,
                        &lightmap_handle,
                        &args,
                        i as f32 * 3.0,
                    );
                    state.lightmap_entities.push(entity);
                }
                state.cycle_count += 1;
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
}

fn handle_input(
    mut commands: Commands,
    mut state: ResMut<State>,
    mut images: ResMut<Assets<Image>>,
    mut meshes: ResMut<Assets<Mesh>>,
    mut materials: ResMut<Assets<StandardMaterial>>,
    keyboard: Res<ButtonInput<KeyCode>>,
    args: Res<Args>,
) {
    if keyboard.just_pressed(KeyCode::Space) {
        println!("Creating 12 lightmaps...");
        for i in 0..12 {
            let mut image = Image::default();
            image.resize(Extent3d {
                width: 32,
                height: 32,
                depth_or_array_layers: 1,
            });
            let lightmap_handle = images.add(image);
            state.lightmap_handles.push(lightmap_handle.clone());

            let entity = create_lightmapped_cube(
                &mut commands,
                &mut meshes,
                &mut materials,
                &lightmap_handle,
                &args,
                i as f32 * 2.0,
            );
            state.lightmap_entities.push(entity);
        }
    }
}

fn create_lightmapped_cube(
    commands: &mut Commands,
    meshes: &mut ResMut<Assets<Mesh>>,
    materials: &mut ResMut<Assets<StandardMaterial>>,
    lightmap_handle: &Handle<Image>,
    args: &Args,
    x_pos: f32,
) -> Entity {
    let mut material = StandardMaterial::default();
    material.lightmap_exposure = 250.0;

    // Create a cube mesh with UV_B coordinates.
    let mut mesh = Mesh::from(Cuboid::new(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));

    // Add UV_B coordinates (using the same as UV_A for simplicity).
    if let Some(VertexAttributeValues::Float32x2(uvs)) = mesh.attribute(Mesh::ATTRIBUTE_UV_0) {
        mesh.insert_attribute(Mesh::ATTRIBUTE_UV_1, uvs.clone());
    }

    commands
        .spawn((
            Mesh3d(meshes.add(mesh)),
            MeshMaterial3d(materials.add(material)),
            Transform::from_xyz(x_pos, 0.0, 0.0),
            Lightmap {
                image: lightmap_handle.clone(),
                bicubic_sampling: args.bicubic,
                ..default()
            },
        ))
        .id()
}
